```{r Load in the OHI Region_Key0}

colnames(Region_Key0)

```

```{r Read in OHI region boundaries}
# Read in OHI region boundaries
ohi_regions <- st_read(here("spatial", "ohi_regions", "goc_ohi_rgns.shp")) %>% 
  st_make_valid()

ohi_land   <- ohi_regions %>% dplyr::filter(location == "land")
ohi_marine <- ohi_regions %>% dplyr::filter(location == "marine")

# Target CRS (to match soft-bottom pressure rasters)
target_crs <- st_crs(ohi_regions)
```

# STEP 2: CALCULATE RHODOLITH "CURRENT EXTENT" less than 100m (source: Hem / CEDO rhodolith data [2025]) ------------------------------

```{r Read in rhodolith layer}

) %>%

print(st_crs(ohi_marine)$Name)

# As points:
CEDO_rhodolith.data_pts <- CEDO_rhodolith.data_raw %>%
```

## Remove all rhodolith beds < 100m

```{r Masks greater than and less than 100m}
# Geopatial mask for less than and greater than 100m depth:
mask_less_than_100m<- rast(
  here("_habitats/HAB_soft_bottom/int/mask_depth_le_100m_1km.tif")
)

# Inspect mask
plot(mask_less_than_100m)

# Shallow water: value 1
shallow_mask <- ifel(mask_less_than_100m == 1, 1, NA)

# Deep water: value 0
deep_mask <- ifel(mask_less_than_100m == 0, 1, NA)

# Convert the mask to polygons
shallow_poly <- as.polygons(
  shallow_mask,
  dissolve = TRUE,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

deep_poly <- as.polygons(
  deep_mask,
  dissolve = TRUE,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

plot(shallow_poly)
plot(deep_poly)
```

```{r Keep rhodolith beds within the <100 m mask}
pts <- terra::vect(CEDO_rhodolith.data_raw)

shallow_poly <- project(shallow_poly, crs(pts))
deep_poly <- project(deep_poly, crs(pts))

shallow_hit <- relate(
  pts, shallow_poly,
  relation = "intersects"
)

deep_hit <- relate(
  pts, deep_poly,
  relation = "intersects"
)

is_shallow <- apply(shallow_hit, 1, any)
is_deep <- apply(deep_hit, 1, any)

# FILTER:
colnames(CEDO_rhodolith.data_raw)

FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area <- CEDO_rhodolith.data_raw %>%
  filter(is_shallow & !is_deep) %>%
  mutate(
    provenance = coalesce(
      na_if(trimws(REFEREN), ""),
      na_if(trimws(source), "")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    habitat, source = provenance, area_ha,
    lat = LATITUD, lon = LONGITU, geometry
  )
# 102 obs., 6 var.

plot(FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area)
```


```{r Check that lat long and area values align with polygon values we would expect}
# Check that the polygon CRS is defined
st_crs(FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area)

# Create point geometries from lon/lat
points_sf <- st_as_sf(
  FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area,
  coords = c("lon", "lat"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

# Transform points into the polygon CRS
points_projected <- st_transform(
  points_sf,
  st_crs(FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area)
)

# Test whether each point falls inside its corresponding polygon
FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area <- FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area %>%
  mutate(
    point_inside = lengths(
      st_covered_by(
        points_projected,
        geometry,
        sparse = TRUE
      )
    ) > 0
  )

# Inspect the results
FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(habitat, lat, lon, point_inside)

table(FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area$point_inside)
# 102 true. Looks good!

# Check polygon area versus reported area:

FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area <- FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area %>%
  mutate(
    polygon_area_ha = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 10000,
    area_difference_ha = polygon_area_ha - area_ha,
    percent_difference = 100 * area_difference_ha / area_ha
  ) %>%
  select(
    habitat, source, area_ha, polygon_area_ha,
    area_difference_ha, percent_difference,
    lat, lon, geometry
  )

```

```{r Assign RHOD extent to each OHI region}
# Assign each Rhodolith polygon to an OHI region (this will drop any land overlap, if applicable):
RHOD_Current_Extent0 <- st_intersection(FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area, ohi_marine) %>%
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON") %>%
  mutate(
    poly_id   = dplyr::row_number(),
    region_id = as.integer(id),
    area_ha = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 10000, 
    area_km2  = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1e6 # NOTE: st_area default unit is m2
  ) %>%
  filter(area_km2 > 0) %>%
  select(habitat, source, area_ha, area_km2, rgn_id, ecorgn, lat, lon, geometry)

RHOD_Current_Extent0

colnames(RHOD_Current_Extent0)

# Assign the rhodolith extent to each OHI region:
RHOD_Current_Extent <- RHOD_Current_Extent0 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  summarise(
    area_ha = sum(area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    area_km2 = sum(area_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
    year = 2025
  )

all_rgns <- tibble(
  rgn_id = paste0("Region_", 1:9),
  year = 2025
)

RHOD_Current_Extent <- all_rgns %>%
  left_join(RHOD_Current_Extent, by = c("rgn_id", "year")) %>%
  mutate(area_km2 = replace_na(area_km2, 0)) %>%
  select(rgn_id, 
         area_est_byCEDO.2025_km2 = area_km2, 
         year)

RHOD_Current_Extent

```

# STEP 3: CALCULATE RHODOLITH "CURRENT STATUS", i.e. condition over time (source: fishing pressure data derived from Villaseñor VMS data, 2007-2025)  ------------------------------

## VMS Fishing Pressure Data (1991-2021)

```{r Read in fishing pressure data}
VMS_fishing_pressure <- rast(
  here("_habitats/HAB_soft_bottom/int/prop_disturbed_soft_bottom_1km.tif")
)

# Check the crs:
print(st_crs(VMS_fishing_pressure)$Name)
# Looks good!
```

```{r Plot rhodolith locations as points vs. fishing pressure in 2025}
land <- terra::project(terra::vect(ohi_land), terra::crs(VMS_fishing_pressure))
marine <- terra::project(terra::vect(ohi_marine), terra::crs(VMS_fishing_pressure))
rhodolith <- terra::project(
  terra::vect(FILTERED_rhodolith.data_area),
  terra::crs(VMS_fishing_pressure)
)

# Select year to plot:
year_map <- 2025
lyr <- match(year_map, years)

# Plot pressure raster first, then overlay vectors
terra::plot(
  VMS_fishing_pressure[[lyr]],
  col = hcl.colors(100, "viridis"),

  axes = FALSE
)

plot(land, add = TRUE,
     col = "gray85", border = "gray60", lwd = 0.5)

     col = NA, border = "gray70", lwd = 0.7)

plot(rhodolith, add = TRUE,
     col = NA, border = "red", lwd = 1)
```

```{r Keep fishing pressure within the <100 m mask}
# Match polygon CRS to the raster CRS
shallow_poly <- project(shallow_poly, crs(VMS_fishing_pressure))
deep_poly   <- project(deep_poly, crs(VMS_fishing_pressure))

# Rasterize polygons onto the raster grid
shallow_mask <- rasterize(
  shallow_poly, VMS_fishing_pressure,
  field = 1, background = NA
)

deep_mask <- rasterize(
  deep_poly, VMS_fishing_pressure,
  field = 1, background = NA
)

# Keep cells inside shallow areas, excluding deep areas
VMS_fishing_pressure_FILTERED <- ifel(
  !is.na(shallow_mask) & is.na(deep_mask),
  VMS_fishing_pressure,
  NA
)

plot(VMS_fishing_pressure)
plot(VMS_fishing_pressure_FILTERED)

# Save original layer names
original_names <- names(VMS_fishing_pressure)

# Restore original layer names
names(VMS_fishing_pressure_FILTERED) <- original_names

plot(VMS_fishing_pressure_FILTERED)
```



## Extract soft-bottom pressure under rhodolith beds

```{r}
pressure_raster <- VMS_fishing_pressure_FILTERED

# Convert rhodolite polygons to a SpatVector
rhodolith_vect <- terra::vect(RHOD_Current_Extent0)

# Match CRS
if (!terra::same.crs(rhodolith_vect, pressure_raster)) {
  rhodolith_vect <- terra::project(
    rhodolith_vect,
    terra::crs(pressure_raster)
  )
}

# Extract mean fishing pressure for each polygon
pressure_values <- terra::extract(
  pressure_raster,
  rhodolith_vect,
  fun = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Join extracted values back to the original polygon data
FILTERED_rhodolith.pressure <- RHOD_Current_Extent0 %>%
  mutate(ID = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(pressure_values, by = "ID") %>%
  select(-ID)
```


Pressure under each bed = area-weighted mean of `VMS_fishing_pressure` cells overlapping the polygon.
No recovery scaling applied for now (same 0–1 exposure scale as soft bottom).
```{r}



# Weighted mean pressure per rhodolith polygon × year
# Note, some rhodolith polygons encompase multiple VMS raster cells, so we need to take the mean:
ex <- terra::extract(
  VMS_fishing_pressure_FILTERED,
  vect(FILTERED_rhodolith.pressure),
  fun = mean,
  weights = TRUE,
  na.rm = TRUE,
  ID = TRUE
)

# Layer names → year; join polygon region + area
# pressure_cols <- setdiff(names(ex), "ID")
# 
# df_poly <- as_tibble(ex) %>%
#   rename(poly_id = ID) %>%
#   left_join(
#     st_drop_geometry(FILTERED_rhodolith.pressure) %>% select(rgn_id, area_km2),
#     by = "poly_id"
#   ) %>%
#   pivot_longer(
#     cols = all_of(pressure_cols),
#     names_to = "layer",
#     values_to = "prop"
#   ) %>%
#   mutate(
#     year = as.integer(sub("VMS_fishing_pressure_", "", layer))
#   )
# 
# df_poly
# 

rhodolith_attributes <- st_drop_geometry(
  FILTERED_rhodolith.pressure
) %>%
  mutate(poly_id = row_number()) %>%
  select(poly_id, rgn_id, area_km2)

df_poly <- as_tibble(ex) %>%
  rename(poly_id = ID) %>%
  left_join(
    rhodolith_attributes,
    by = "poly_id"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(pressure_cols),
    names_to = "layer",
    values_to = "prop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(
      sub("prop_disturbed_", "", layer)
    )
  )

df_poly

# Prop = average predicted probability of fishing disturbance per rhodolith bed x year.
# Example, if prop = 0.7, this means an average predicted disturbance probability of 70% across the extracted cells.
```

```{r}
# Area-weighted average pressure per region × year
RHOD_Scores0 <- df_poly %>%
  filter(!is.na(prop), !is.na(rgn_id), area_km2 > 0) %>%
  group_by(rgn_id, year) %>%
  summarise(
    area_sum  = sum(area_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Pressure  = sum(prop * area_km2, na.rm = TRUE) / area_sum,
    RHO_score = 1 - Pressure,
    Pressure  = Pressure * 100,
    RHO_score = RHO_score * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

RHOD_Scores0

```

```{r Join rgn_name to scores}
colnames(Region_Key)
colnames(RHOD_Scores0)

RHOD_Scores <- RHOD_Scores0 %>%
  left_join(Region_Key, by = "rgn_id")
  
RHOD_Scores<- RHOD_Scores %>%
  relocate(rgn_name, .before = rgn_id)
```

## Current RHO
```{r}
# Select a single year
year_to_show <- 2025   # <-- change this to any year you want

# Filter for selected year
pressure_year <- RHOD_Scores %>%
  filter(year == year_to_show) %>%
  arrange(region_id)

# Make a kable table
pressure_year %>%
  select(region_id, Pressure, RHO_score) %>%
  kable(
    digits = 4,
    col.names = c("Region ID", "Pressure", "RHO_score"),
    align = c("c", "r", "r")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered", "hover"),
    full_width = FALSE
  ) %>%
  add_header_above(
    setNames(3, paste0("Rhodolith Pressure & RHO — Year ", year_to_show))
  )
```

```{r}
ohi_rho <- ohi_regions %>%
  left_join(
    pressure_year %>% transmute(id = as.integer(region_id), RHO_score),
    by = "id"
  )
ohi_land_map   <- ohi_rho %>% filter(location == "land")
ohi_marine_map <- ohi_rho %>% filter(location == "marine")
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = ohi_land_map, fill = "#f5e6c8", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = ohi_marine_map, aes(fill = RHO_score), color = "gray20", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_distiller(
    palette = "RdYlGn",
    direction = 1,
    name = "RHO score",
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20),
    na.value = "gray90"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Rhodolith habitat status (2025)") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
  RHOD_Scores,
  aes(
    x = year,
    y = RHO_score,
    group = region_clean,
    color = region_clean
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = rgn_colors_clean) +
  labs(
    title = "RHO Score Over Time",
    x = "Year",
    y = "RHO Score",
    color = "Region ID"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

## Format and save data

```{r}
# Calculate condition score (0–100), same pattern as soft bottom
condition_df <- RHOD_Scores %>%
  select(region_id, year, condition = RHO_score) %>%
  mutate(
    condition = pmin(condition, 100)
  )
condition_df

write_csv(
  condition_df,
  here("_habitats/HAB_rhodolith_beds/RHO_outputs/rho_status.csv")
)

condition_df <- condition_df %>%
  mutate(region_id = factor(region_id, levels = 1:9))
ggplot(condition_df, aes(x = year, y = condition)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ region_id, ncol = 3, labeller = labeller(region_id = function(x) paste("Region", x))) +

  ) +

```

# STEP 5: ESTIMATE RHOD TREND (source: multiple data sources, 2007-present) ------------------------------

```{r}
# Trend Calculation: lm for most recent 5 years of data
year_end <- max(condition_df$year, na.rm = TRUE)
year_start <- year_end - 4
calc_trends <- function(d) {
  ys <- min(d$year)
  ye <- max(d$year)
  cs <- d$condition[d$year == ys][1]
  fit_lin <- lm(condition ~ year, data = d)
  fit_log <- lm(log(pmax(condition, 1e-6)) ~ year, data = d)
  slope_lin <- unname(coef(fit_lin)["year"])
  slope_log <- unname(coef(fit_log)["year"])
  tibble(
    year = ye,
    year_start = ys,
    year_end = ye,
    condition_start = cs,
    trend_pct_linear = (slope_lin / cs) * 100,
    trend_pct_cagr   = (exp(slope_log) - 1) * 100
  )
}
trend_df <- condition_df %>%
  filter(year >= year_start, year <= year_end) %>%
  group_by(region_id) %>%
  group_modify(~ calc_trends(.x)) %>%
  ungroup()

trend_df
```

```{r}
write_csv(
  trend_df,
  here("_habitats/HAB_rhodolith_beds/RHO_outputs/rho_trend.csv")
)
```
